title: Disney world, apartment hunting, and the Ice Wall
content: Title is the three big recurring locations in my dreams, and the first two have heavy parallels with the last hour spent perusing this sub and I wanna see if other have similar locations First, the Disney world dreams. My family visited Disney a lot when I was younger, but in my dreams it's less of the park and more of a giant indoor mall area-- theaters, different rooms for rides, a somehow indoor area that leads to the waterslide going down that you can also drive your car across, and also an outdoor area as well. From the inside, you csn drive down the waterslide that takes you to the giant Ice Wall, close to the north pole. And thats the path i take to drive home in my dreams lol Second, the apartment hunting. I have constant stress dreams about finding a new place to live (like, for years now), and i have recurring dreams of checking out/moving into a giant luxury (I'm assuming, I've never experienced it lol) apartment-home complex that seems kind of infinite and also seems to be directly above some kind of mall-like shops Idk, anyone else have similar recurring locations lol? I've had recurring dreams in the school mall mentioned in this sub before, but i feel like it's been a while since I've dreamed there. More of the ice wall travel to the Disney mall water park lately lol
